deploy plan takes the environment's deploy lock, and saves the plan to .promptarena/envs/<env>/deploy.plan for a later deploy apply to the same environment.

Before planning, the CLI sends the merged deploy config to the adapter's validate_config. If the adapter reports it invalid, the command stops with deploy config is invalid for "<provider>": <reasons>. An adapter that does not implement validate_config is planned without it.
status never compiles the pack, so it works even when the arena config does not compile.
The CLI reads config.arena.yaml by default. When there is no config.arena.yaml but there is an arena.yaml, it reads arena.yaml.

deploy apply reuses the environment's saved plan when the pack checksum matches the plan, and otherwise prints 'Saved plan is stale (the pack changed since it was planned), re-planning...'. The checksum ignores the pack's compile time.
deploy lock is held by another process: the message names its pid; the operating system releases the lock when that process exits.
Legacy .promptarena/deploy.state is used only for the environment it records; run deploy status --env <environment> once to move it.
The adapter's stderr is shown in the terminal; when an adapter exits mid-command, the error ends with the last lines it wrote to stderr.
The CLI deletes the environment's state file and saved plan after destroy.
